steps.title: The Workshop
steps.setting: The Galactic C's workshop, a converted passenger galley: chrome, teal vinyl, a cassette deck playing low, tools everywhere. Through the porthole, Truevivor III turns below, ringed by orbital defence stations. Ashe leans on the workbench, his plain claymore on the bench behind him. Dust has just brought two mugs of coffee.

beats.narrate: Orbit over Truevivor III. The Galactic C's workshop. A cassette deck plays low. Ashe leans on the workbench, grease to the shoulder; his plain claymore lies behind him. Dust hands him a mug of coffee.
Ashe shakes his head with a knowing smile.
Dust just shakes his head.
Silence a moment.
A distant explosion. Ashe and Dust look up, then think nothing of it.
Another distant explosion, a bit louder. It's ignored.
Boots pound down the corridor. Statda skids past the open hatch: dark blue coveralls, coke-bottle glasses.
She runs on toward the cockpit.
Ashe returns to the conversation, not even considering what Statda said.
Another explosion, closer. And more beyond it. Ashe is now paying attention.

beats.tip: Options marked in gold need a stat. Dust meets this one. Special options always lead somewhere better, or more interesting, than the rest.

beats.narrate: A claymore on the bench. Plain steel: no enamel, no gold, no name engraved. Oiled, edge dressed. It looks like it was forged yesterday.
Dust's curved two-hander. A chip bites into the guard, never dressed out.
Dust opens his mouth. Nothing comes out.
Dust blushes deep red.

choice.text: Count the gaps between the explosions.

beats.narrate: Dust listens. Boom. Four seconds. Boom. Three. Each one closer than the last, walking a straight line toward the hull.
Ashe looks at him for one long second. Then he sets the mug down, picks up the claymore, and slings it.
The explosions start happening around the craft. The deck bucks; the lights stutter.
Static crackles over the intercom.
Static interrupts.
With much more static, a different voice, thick with a mercenary accent:
It cuts out.
Ashe and Dust run for the cockpit: down the corridor, the deck pitching under their boots, red light strobing, a porthole full of tracer fire flashing past.

steps.title: The Cockpit
steps.setting: Wraparound viewports; Truevivor III fills the glass; orange tracers lance up from the orbital stations. Deena at the console on the right, Statda on the left, K'saabu filling the hatch behind them.

beats.narrate: The cockpit. Truevivor III fills the viewports; orange tracers lance up from the orbital stations. Deena is at the console on the right. Statda is on the left. K'saabu fills the hatch behind them, cannon under one arm.
Ashe drops into the pilot's seat. Deena and Statda both wave Dust over.

beats.tip: There will be many choices and actions you make that build or lose affection with the other heroes. Whoever you stand by gets a small boost in affection. Whomever you don't stand by... in this case, also gets a small boost, because it's the tutorial. But dialogue options change. Don't expect such ease of action in the future, recruit.

beats.narrate: Deena's lips move. She thinks nobody can hear her.
Statda pushes her glasses up and whispers to herself, too low for anyone but Dust.
Statda stands with her arms crossed, shaking her head.
Nobody looks at K'saabu.

choice.text: Hey. We're getting out of this. All of us.
Hell of a crew to stick around for.
The station's not the worst idea.

beats.narrate: He thumps Dust on the back hard enough to stagger him.
A heavy CLANG. The whole ship lurches sideways. Red emergency lights flood the cockpit.
The EMP hits. Her voice dies mid-word. Every screen goes black. The engines die. Silence, except the wind starting to howl against the hull.
Then rifle fire punches through the cockpit hatch: the boarders' first wave. Everyone hits the deck.
ALTITUDE 9,000 m. It drops every combat round and every walk between fights. It won't fail you; it decides how well Ashe lands.

steps.title: The Lounge
prompts: Top of the screen's the timeline, recruit. Shows who moves next. Faster folks go more often.
Move, then act. One action a turn. Those seats are half cover. Use 'em.
The one with the shotgun hits hardest. Put the big one down first. Three wounded men still shoot. One dead one don't.
Hit 'em from the side or the back and it hurts more.
You and me can Mend. Small heal, costs Focus. Don't wait till you're on the floor.

beats.narrate: Cut to the aft hallway. Statda ducks into the med bay and comes out with a long rifle.

steps.title: The Aft Hallway

intro.narrate: He steps in front of Deena.

prompts: Deena's fast. She'll move before almost anyone. She's also made of glass. Keep her in cover.
Deena's got one Stun Grenade. Save it. You'll want it later.
Pass Turn: Deena can hand her turn to someone else, right now. Cooldown's three rounds.
K'saabu's slow, but every cannon shot hits a three-by-three. Nothing in this hallway to break. Let him off the leash.
Most places won't be this empty. Civilians, hostages, delicate gear: they all get hit too. Move 'em, or don't fire.
Statda's a sniper. Long range, hits hard. She carries a Medkit too: a solid heal for anyone within reach. Limited supply.
K'saabu can raise a shield and Taunt. Make 'em shoot the big man, not the mechanic.

beats.narrate: Ashe and Dust meet the others at the bulkhead outside the embarkation bay.

steps.title: The Embarkation Bay

intro.narrate: The crew crouch behind the check-in desk, looking through the open bulkhead at the boarders. Their uniforms match. Nothing else does: every weapon is different, in different states of repair.

prompts: Five of you now. More guns, more options. Don't waste 'em.
Anybody can Search. Takes an action. Sharper eyes find more. Deena's got the sharpest.
The Sergeant's got a Deflector. Shoot into it and it shoots you back, cannon included. Split him off from his boys.

fail_hints.reflected: Firing into the Deflector bounced the shot straight back. Search first, or separate the Sergeant from his squad.
fail_hints.deena: Deena went down in the open. Keep her in cover, and let K'saabu Taunt.

beats.narrate: On the Sergeant's body: under the Unity collar, a tattoo of a candle with an open mouth, and a data tape. Dust plays a second of it: the Galactic C's exact flight plan, filed privately with the Srov two days ago.

Ashe sprints for the cockpit. Deena sits on the floor against a luggage cart, pistol in her lap, staring at the trooper she shot. Statda kneels beside her, opens her Medkit, and starts on the cut over Deena's eye without being asked.
He helps her up. K'saabu lumbers over and wraps them both in an enormous hug, lifting them off the floor.
The ship's nose drops. The roar becomes a scream. Through the viewports the Neon Slums bloom out of the clouds, impossibly fast. The screen floods white.
Black. One second of silence.

steps.title: The Warehouse
steps.setting: Morning-dark in the Neon Slums of Truevivor III. Rain. The Galactic C is embedded nose-first in the side of a warehouse, three storeys up, steaming, neon signs flickering around the hole.

beats.narrate: Morning-dark in the Neon Slums of Truevivor III. Rain. The Galactic C is embedded nose-first in the side of a warehouse, three storeys up, steaming.
A door bangs open below. A short, broad woman in a neon raincoat stalks out into the rain and glares up at the ship in her wall.

Then the gangers pour out around her: mohawks, chains, electro-axes, mismatched armour. A dozen of them fan out from the warehouse and the alleys. Every weapon points up at the crew. None of them moves until she does.
Act I begins.
